name: How long does kitchen painting typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen painting typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen painting depends on several factors, including the size of your kitchen, the current condition of the surfaces, and the scope of work. A typical kitchen painting project involving cabinets, walls, and trim can take anywhere from 3 to 7 days. This includes time for preparation, priming, painting multiple coats, and drying between coats. More complex projects with extensive repairs or custom finishes may take longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen painting usually takes 3-7 days, depending on kitchen size and project complexity.
